summary: The launch failed during immutable-input preflight because a split source-pose archive with arms_packed and hands_packed keys was supplied to the unified robot-limb packed-mask interface.
evidence: The process stopped in _load_packed before decoding or modifying a candidate frame.
The supplied source-pose archive has arms_packed and hands_packed keys but no packed key.
The independent robot-limb archive has the required packed key and covers all 660 frames.
lessons: Source semantic limb supports and unified generated-robot limb locks are separate mask contracts and must not be interchanged implicitly.
limitations: This attempt produced no video and no quality result.
next_actions: Rerun unchanged consensus gates in a new output directory using the unified generated-robot limb archive.
